name: keyzori
description: Self-hosted software licensing API and HTTP administration CLI.

scripts.setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run scripts/plugins.ts install
scripts.test:unit: bun test tests/unit tests/http/responses.test.ts tests/plugins/loader.test.ts tests/services/policy.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run lint && bun run db:check
scripts.check:server: bun run typecheck && bun test tests/http tests/services
scripts.db:generate: bunx --bun drizzle-kit generate && bun run scripts/plugins.ts generate
scripts.db:check: bunx --bun drizzle-kit check && bun run scripts/plugins.ts check && bun run scripts/checkMigrations.ts
